evidence.quote: Over three years (six semesters), you will gain in-depth knowledge of computer science
Classes are held entirely in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR

notes: The DAAD page gives a tuition fee of 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants, which corresponds to the institution-wide fee stated on the DHBW application page for international students who are non-EU/EEA residents. The programme page and the DAAD page do not state any application deadline for this programme; the general admission page states an official semester start of 1 October each year, but not as an application deadline for the New Study Computer Science programme.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, proof via placement test/interview

note.fr: L'admission est possible après vérification de l'équivalence de votre diplôme étranger par le Bureau central international de la DHBW.
note.en: Admission is possible after the Central International Office of DHBW has assessed the equivalency of your foreign qualification.

evidence.quote: Enrolment of international degree seeking students, who received their university entrance qualification abroad, is only possible after the assessment of equivalency.

note.fr: Un contrat de formation pratique avec une entreprise partenaire est requis ; vous devez d'abord postuler directement auprès de l'entreprise.
note.en: A training contract with a partner company is required; you first have to apply directly to the company.

evidence.quote: Enrollment at the university is only possible after a training contract with a workplace training provider has been signed.
